name: Autodesk Product Help
description: The Autodesk Product Help MCP Server connects AI agents directly to Autodesk's official product documentation, enabling accurate, real-time answers across 110+ products. As a secure, read-only interface, it allows AI tools to search, navigate, and retrieve trusted Autodesk help content. This enables support for natural language queries, accelerates onboarding, and provides a reliable foundation for intelligent agents built on authoritative Autodesk product documentation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Autodesk Product Help to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Autodesk Product Help to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://developer.api.autodesk.com/knowledge/public/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Autodesk Product Help MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Autodesk Product Help scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Autodesk Product Help MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autodesk Product Help provides these MCP tools: get_available_products and search_help_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Autodesk Product Help?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Autodesk Product Help in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, PomoDial, and Soracom Knowledge.

_published_faq.name: Does Autodesk Product Help MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autodesk Product Help does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Autodesk Product Help is developed by Autodesk, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
